messages:
Sophie L: quick check — we pulled a dev debug bundle from staging and it looks like a base64 blob that might be an API key in a few logs. who has KMS/HSM decrypt perms for staging keys? :eyes:
Jamal R: :rotating_light: do we know which service/account wrote the logs? any customer data exposed?
Sophie L: it's from the image-processing job on staging, only internal test data but still not ideal. blob shows prefix 'ak_live_' and a bunch of chars. unsure which key it maps to.
Mina K: if it's prefixed like that probably not a KMS ciphertext — could be a plain API key recorded by a library. first step: treat it as compromised and rotate the key.
Alex B: I can rotate the affected key if we identify the customer/service. recommend issuing a short-lived replacement via Vault and patching the service.
Sophie L: thx. who can create a Vault token and update the staging config? we want to avoid manual copy-paste to reduce risk.
security-bot: created incident ticket INC-4321 for "staging debug leak - possible API key" and added audit watchers. See https://redwood.internal/inc/INC-4321
Jamal R: quick checklist: 1) deny the exposed key 2) rotate in Vault 3) patch service to use new secret 4) scan other logs for similar blobs 5) audit who accessed the old key.
Mina K: for scanning, use this grep snippet on compressed logs:
```bash
zgrep -aE "ak_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}" /var/logs/archive/*.gz | less
```
Mina K: also run the KMS audit to check decrypt calls: look for principal/service-account and timestamp within the window. if there's any Decrypt calls that don't match the service, escalate.
Alex B: note — in staging our KMS grants are scoped to service accounts; humans shouldn't have Decrypt. if someone does, that's misconfigured and we should remove the IAM binding.
Sophie L: low-friction short-term plan: Alex rotates key, I patch the job to use Vault reference, Mina runs log scan & KMS audit, Jamal files a PR to sanitize log output to never print full keys.
Jamal R: PR checklist suggestion: replace any token-like string with `*****` and add unit test to assert masking for future logs.
Mina K: long term: enable/redact at logger level and add a pre-commit rule to catch accidental prints of keys (regex-based). also limit staging keys TTL to 24h.
Alex B: I'll take rotation now and post the new Vault path here when done. tagging @Ops Robin for deployment window if needed.
Ops Robin: I can deploy a hotfix to staging out-of-band, no blackout. ping me when new secret is ready. :thumbsup:
Sophie L: thanks everyone. once rotation & patch are done I'll close INC-4321 and post a short blameless note in #postmortems for visibility.
security-bot: audit log export queued for INC-4321, ETA 10m.
Alex B: rotated, new secret at vault://kv/staging/imageproc/token@v3 (don't copy raw), deployment queued with Ops Robin.
Mina K: scan finished — found 2 more occurrences in older archives, rotated those too, updated ticket. no unexpected KMS decrypts found.
Jamal R: added masking PR: https://github.com/redwood/imageproc/pull/281, tests included.
Sophie L: closing loop — INC-4321 updated, postmortem draft incoming. appreciate the quick ops. :lock:"
